**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Mrs Mercier](../persons.html#990),
I enclose a cheque for the remainder of Campanella and send at the same time a proof of Mr Peabody, hoping you will not sacrifice the modest request which seems to me too good to be lost.

Thank you for [Miss Tucker’](../persons.html#1424)s address I hope she has heard from [Mr Warne](../persons.html#1433) by this time[^2]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
Lady Betty is an admirable story

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

[^2]: Miss Tucker may perhaps have been author of one of the [Victoria Tales and Stories](../books.html#211) series edited by CMY and published by Warne.
